registration_status: Internal analysis plan fixed before the new case analyses; not a preregistration. Prior summary results were already available.
inclusion: These five public-source desk-verified production sites only; no candidate site enters the primary case analysis.
climate_unit: Unique accepted representative-point grid. Shared grids are not repeated climate observations; distinct grids are not assumed statistically independent.
threshold_interpretation: Inherited project threshold, not an occupational limit or an asserted exact conversion of an official Fahrenheit category boundary.
complete_summer: Exactly the expected JJA dates, no duplicate date, and all daily values finite. Annual summaries and episodes use complete summers only.

episode.definition: A maximal run of consecutive calendar days with daily maximum HI >= 40.6 Celsius, contained within one complete JJA season.
episode.boundary_censoring: Flag runs touching June 1 or August 31; the full process may extend outside the observed JJA season.
episode.interpretation: Threshold episode, not a formally defined heatwave or an independent meteorological event.

typical: Minimum absolute distance between annual threshold-day count and its complete-summer median
year_selection.ties: Retain all first-criterion candidates and the final tie-break decision. Do not choose years after inspecting the desired narrative.

spatial.geometry: Archived OSM factory polygons; not cadastral or field-survey validation
spatial.partition: Nearest-centre regions of the original latitude and longitude axes; this is the project's point-matching partition, not a factory-scale physical climate footprint
spatial.area: Intersect true polygons with coordinate partitions; report projected equal-area areas and fractions, projection and software versions, closure and an area-method cross-check
spatial.outside_centroid: Retain and flag; do not adopt as a valid in-factory primary point
spatial.mask: Retain masked intersections and their area; never renormalize only the unmasked portion into a whole-factory estimate
spatial.primary_result: Unchanged; alternative land grids cannot replace a masked primary grid
spatial.delta: Compute numeric differences only when both the accepted primary and the comparison grid have valid metrics
